thesis: Convex preference regions and cones follow from fixed procedures and expected utilities; other geometric claims need separate tests.

ideas.statement: Convex preference regions and cones follow from fixed procedures and expected utilities; other geometric claims need separate tests.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Squared radius makes annulus membership simple by discarding angle, leaving directional questions unanswered.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Cones are not all concepts, entailment and utility cones differ, and simple tables may outperform attractive geometries.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
